newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust files $3.08 bln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust files $3.08 bln shelf offer.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $3.08 billion in debt securities, common stock, preferred shares and depositary shares.
BT Securities Corp and other affiliates of the company may offer and sell securities under the shelf registration in their business as broker-dealers, according to the SEC filing.
Proceeds from the sale will be used by the New York-based bank holding company for general corporate purposes, which may include investments in the company's subsidiaries.
The shelf offering includes previously registered securities.
